## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in Charted Currents.

## Evidence / sources

For historical or data changes, list the source records, URLs/identifiers, evidence state, and relevant reuse-rights notes.

## Product impact

- [ ] Map / exploration
- [ ] Entity model or resolution
- [ ] ETL / data pipeline

## Historical integrity checklist

- [ ] No unsourced historical facts were added.
- [ ] Inference is not presented as observation.
- [ ] Ambiguous entity matches remain explicitly uncertain.
- [ ] Source/item rights were checked for any added historical content or assets.
- [ ] Forced migration / slavery content follows the project's historical-ethics guidance.

## Validation

Describe checks run and any limitations or follow-up work.
